objective: Skip creation of the optional 5090 tunnel when the remote VLM is not listening, while preserving the verified 4090 primary route and automatic 5090 enablement when ready.

implementation.remote_preflight: Read-only SSH curl to 127.0.0.1:18878/v1/models with bounded connect and request timeouts
implementation.unready_behavior: Do not create the optional tunnel; emit one bounded fallback message and continue with 4090
implementation.ready_behavior: Create and verify the existing optional tunnel exactly as before

decision.reason: The missing 5090 VLM is rejected before tunnel creation, the refusal log no longer grows, startup remains healthy on 4090, and formal state is byte-identical.

limits: The 5.680 second and prior 9.919 second values are single warm-model startup samples, not a latency distribution.
This removes optional-route startup waste; it does not reduce SAM or VLM inference latency.
The ready-5090 branch is covered by a controlled unit test but was not live-tested because no 5090 VLM was listening.
No SAM3 fine-tuning, VLM post-training, candidate write, truth write, training approval or OSS write occurred.
